output.population: Patients whose echocardiography reports appear in the MIMIC-III-derived ECHO-NOTE2NUM dataset; the model was developed on Mayo Clinic reports and validated on MIMIC-EchoNote reports.
output.summary: MIMIC-III echocardiography reports annotated by EchoGraph, a BERT-based extraction model, with entity and relation labels covering clinical observations, anatomical structures, measurements and relation types, supporting clinical NLP and echocardiography AI research.
